tooltip.data_center_addon.powered_server: Seals a server room like any wall block and carries energy (FE) through it.
Ports on both ends: place it against the wall face, connect a cable or battery on each side.
data_center_addon.configuration.title: Data Center AddOn
data_center_addon.configuration.parts.to: Real computer parts added by this add-on.
data_center_addon.configuration.hideOrig: Hide Data Center's own (fictional brand) parts from the Shop. Parts you already own keep working. Takes effect the next time a world is loaded.
data_center_addon.configuration.hiddenCa: Shop categories in which the original parts are hidden when 'Hide Original Parts' is on.
data_center_addon.configuration.storageB: Capacity multiplier for this add-on's storage parts while their server runs in a Hosting Rack. 1.0 turns it off.
In-game overlay with the Data Center date and crypto prices.
Show the overlay. Can also be toggled with a key (Controls > Data Center).
data_center_addon.configuration.anchor.t: Screen corner or edge the overlay sticks to.
Horizontal distance from the position in GUI pixels (positive = towards the screen center).
Vertical distance from the position in GUI pixels (positive = towards the screen center).
data_center_addon.configuration.hideInSc: Hide the overlay while a menu or inventory is open. Chat keeps it visible.
data_center_addon.configuration.hideWith: Hide the overlay while the F3 debug screen is shown.
data_center_addon.configuration.appearan: Look of the overlay. Colors are #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB.
data_center_addon.configuration.style.to: Tooltip: box like an item tooltip. Flat: plain box. None: text only.
data_center_addon.configuration.dateForm: Java date pattern, in the game's language. Examples: 'EEE, d MMM yyyy' = Mon, 3 Jan 2011, 'dd.MM.yyyy' = 03.01.2011, 'yyyy-MM-dd' = 2011-01-03.
data_center_addon.configuration.prices.t: Crypto prices (USD per coin) on the in-game date.
data_center_addon.configuration.coins.to: Coins to show, in this order.
data_center_addon.configuration.showUnla: Also list coins that do not trade yet on the in-game date (shown as '-').
data_center_addon.configuration.coloredT: Color each ticker in its coin's color.
data_center_addon.configuration.showChan: Show the price change in percent.
data_center_addon.configuration.changeDa: Period of the price change in in-game days (1 = since yesterday, 7 = since a week ago).
data_center_addon.configuration.showWall: Show the USD balance of your wallet.
data_center_addon.configuration.showCoin: Also show what the coins in your wallet are worth in USD at today's prices (only when you hold any).
